subject: f:oriented_slot:1
evidence: An OrientedSlot's source passage frame (run sense, u and v) is chosen canonically by the run's dominant component, and its width and long directions by their largest component, in the frame it is recognised in: Python's working frame, mapped here into the part's, and quiddity-rust's caller space, the file's. So the same slot is expressed with other senses and another in-plane basis (quiddity-rust's tests/fixtures/known_framed_document.json (mfcadpp_holdout/467.step, oriented_slots, caller_space, equivalent) shows the same mechanism between quiddity-rust's own default frame and caller space, for the one corpus part with an oriented slot). Checked for each slot: the slot's prism (its section's four vertices at both ends of its run interval, in the part's coordinates from origin, run, u and v) is the same eight points on both sides, its width, length, centre, ends, faces and body key agree, and its run, width and long directions agree up to sense. draftwright reads none of these fields (the port draws and lints no oriented slot; its fingerprint takes width and length, which agree).
